background:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original illustrated 2DGP production-ident background, landscape 5:3 canvas.
Create a polished, playful independent visual identity for "2DGP", a creative 2D graphics project. This is the BACKGROUND LAYER ONLY, no lettering.
Scene: a graphic miniature cosmos, large charming stylized planets and crisp floating voxel-like square fragments orbiting around a generous empty center. Deep cobalt/indigo space with restrained turquoise glow, a warm coral ringed planet near the lower left edge, a luminous turquoise small planet near the upper right edge, little square stars and clean sweeping orbital arcs framing the composition. One coherent designed illustration, premium animated studio-ident mood, confident shapes, crisp cel shading with subtle soft gradients, tangible rounded toy-like surfaces, limited purposeful detail. No photorealism.
Composition: full-bleed 1600x960-style horizontal frame. Keep the central region (x 22%-78%, y 28%-65%) dark, quiet and almost empty so a large foreground wordmark can sit there legibly. Rich decorative forms mostly along the perimeter, with balanced visual weight. Make the peripheral illustration distinctive and beautiful, not a presentation template.
Constraints: original independent art, absolutely NO dungeon, stone ruins, medieval fantasy, tools, repair worker, skeleton, demon, sword, hammer, or any character from a game. NO text, NO letters, NO numerals, NO labels, NO watermark, no UI. Opaque full background.
letters:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: transparent two-cell sprite atlas for an original 2DGP production ident.
Make a wide 2:1 transparent canvas split invisibly into TWO equal square cells in ONE ROW. Exact text in left cell: "2D". Exact text in right cell: "GP". This is one identity split into two separately animated groups. Spell characters exactly: numeral 2, capital D, capital G, capital P. NO other text.
Typography: bold, playful, bespoke rounded chunky geometric sans wordmark, beautifully crafted glossy toy-like extruded lettering, confident broad silhouettes and gently beveled edges, clean cel-shaded highlights. Front faces of 2D are luminous ice cyan; front faces of GP are warm coral orange with a touch of golden yellow highlight. Both use a consistent thick deep-navy edge and restrained navy extrusion down-right. Frontal readable camera with subtle dimensional thickness, not an isometric oblique view. Fun creative studio identity for a colorful space/planet illustration.
Layout requirements for splitting down the exact center: each group centered within its own square cell, same apparent cap height and same baseline. Each group's visible bounding box approximately 76% of cell width and 50% of cell height. Leave at least 10% completely transparent margin on ALL sides of each cell. Keep the central dividing line entirely transparent; absolutely no shapes crossing between the cells. Letters within each group may sit close together, but the two groups are clearly separated. No shared base plate or backing plaque.
Only the two letter groups on true transparent alpha. No planets, stars, particles, illustrations, backdrop, visible grid, checkerboard, drop-shadow rectangle, ground plane, or other objects. Absolutely no dungeon, stone lettering, medieval ornaments, game characters, tools, swords, or fantasy imagery. Crisp clean alpha edges.
